headline: Binance Freezes $2.5B in Assets and Vows to Cover Losses Following Hack
summary: Binance suspended transactions and froze $2.5 billion in assets amid a suspected hack, pledging to cover all losses. Exchange reserve data indicated the drained wallets left its ether backing roughly 6% short.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange. Security incidents and reserve deficits at major crypto venues raise concerns over counterparty solvency and market liquidity.

impacts.name: Ethereum
impacts.why: Exchange reserve depletion and security concerns create selling pressure and liquidity friction.
